fact: On 8 October 2026 Egypt's communications and labour ministries signed an MoU for programmes building the digital capacities of Labour Ministry employees at headquarters, directorates, labour offices and training centres.
system: MCIT-Ministry of Labor MoU digital capacity programmes

fact: Egypt's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology runs a four-pillar digital capability programme for employees of the State's administrative apparatus, delivered through distance learning by ITIDA, NTI and the National Anti-Corruption Academy.
The Fundamentals of Digital Skills Program, implemented by ICDL Arabia, targets all employees of the state's administrative apparatus.
MCIT and the Ministry of Labour signed an MoU for programmes to build Labour Ministry employees' digital capacities, covering its headquarters, directorates and labour offices.

Egypt's National Telecommunication Institute and the State Lawsuits Authority signed a protocol for digital, AI and cybersecurity training of judicial counselors, extending the AI Ambassadors Program whose second cohort is under way, per MCIT.
MCIT says participants in its Decent Life digital-skills workshops included government officials, among other groups.
